from decimal import Decimal


def ingest_event(connection, event):
    if event["channel"] != "direct":
        raise ValueError("unsupported channel")
    connection.execute(
        "INSERT INTO orders "
        "(event_id, channel, source_order_id, amount_cents, currency, recipient_name) "
        "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (
            event["event_id"],
            event["channel"],
            event["external_order_id"],
            int(Decimal(event["amount"]) * 100),
            event["currency"],
            event["recipient_name"],
        ),
    )
    connection.execute(
        "INSERT INTO order_events (event_id, event_type) VALUES (?, ?)",
        (event["event_id"], "created"),
    )
    connection.commit()

import sqlite3
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parents[2] / "src"))
from order_ingest import ingest_event

connection = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
connection.executescript(
    "CREATE TABLE orders (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, event_id TEXT, channel TEXT, "
    "source_order_id TEXT, amount_cents INTEGER, currency TEXT, recipient_name TEXT);"
    "CREATE TABLE order_events (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, event_id TEXT, event_type TEXT);"
)
event = {
    "event_id": "evt-public-direct-1001",
    "channel": "direct",
    "external_order_id": "D-PUBLIC-1001",
    "amount": "19.95",
    "currency": "CNY",
    "recipient_name": "Public Fixture"
}
ingest_event(connection, event)
row = connection.execute(
    "SELECT channel, source_order_id, amount_cents, currency, recipient_name "
    "FROM orders WHERE event_id = ?",
    (event["event_id"],),
).fetchone()
assert row == ("direct", "D-PUBLIC-1001", 1995, "CNY", "Public Fixture")
print("public direct regression passed")
